### Kroger wines earn elite scores at every price point


October 28, 2026


*Seven wines across three exclusive labels receive 91- to 93-point ratings from Wine Enthusiast and James Suckling*


CINCINNATI


, Oct. 28, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR), America's grocer, today announced that six wines from its exclusive portfolio received scores of 91 points or higher from two of the wine world's most respected critics, *Wine Enthusiast* and James Suckling.


The scores span three Kroger-exclusive labels and three price tiers, with the highest-rated bottle earning 93 points from James Suckling and the most affordable earning 92 points and a Best Buy designation from *Wine Enthusiast* , at just $7.99 a bottle.


"These scores are a reminder that great wine does not have to come with a big price tag," said Curtis Mann, Master of Wine and vice president of adult beverage at Kroger. "We are obsessive about how we invest in sourcing and quality across our wine portfolio. Seeing that work validated by well-respected critics across multiple varietals and price points tells us we're getting it right."


Four Domaine A'Dair wines received scores of 91 points or higher from *Wine Enthusiast* :


- **Domaine A'Dair Pinot Grigio 2025** : 92 points Best Buy
- **Domaine A'Dair Sauvignon Blanc 2025** : 91 points
- **Domaine A'Dair Chardonnay 2024** : 91 points
- **Domain A'Dair Cabernet Sauvignon 2024** : 91 points


At $7.99 per bottle, Domaine A'Dair delivers critically acclaimed California wine at a price that makes it an easy everyday choice.


Two additional wines earned recognition from James Suckling:


- **Odd Lot Cabernet Sauvignon/Syrah Blend 2023** : 91 points
- **Three Graces Cabernet Sauvignon 2023** : 93 points


The Three Graces Cabernet Sauvignon 2023's score places the wine firmly in company typically associated with bottles well above $30.


All wines are available at Kroger Family of Stores locations nationwide and at[Kroger.com](http://kroger.com/)
